graph.num_vertices: <int> Total number of vertices in the graph.
graph.num_edges: <int> Total number of undirected edges in the graph.
graph.max_degree: <int> Highest number of neighbors any single vertex has.
graph.avg_degree: <float> Average number of neighbors per vertex across the entire graph.
graph.adjacency_list: <dict, key: '{vertex}'> For each vertex, the sorted list of vertices it is directly connected to by an edge.
